limitations: Evaluation consists of groups reserved for these edits from a historical model evaluation split; not a newly collected benchmark.
Native order only: rotation/order-stability claims are unsupported by this experiment.
Fit and tuning labels influenced direction, column selection and candidate choice.
Bootstrap intervals are paired document-group descriptive intervals without multiplicity adjustment.
Internal matrix delta algebra is subject to FP32 rounding; actual-forward verification is required.
